english: Let $S=\left\{x\in[0,2\pi]:x\neq\dfrac{\pi}{2},\ x\neq\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\ \text{and}\ \cos^{-1}(\cos x)<3\tan^{-1}(\tan x)\right\}$, where the inverse trigonometric functions take their principal values. If the sum of the lengths of the intervals that constitute $S$ is $k\pi$, then the value of $k$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $S=\left\{x\in[0,2\pi]:x\neq\dfrac{\pi}{2},\ x\neq\dfrac{3\pi}{2},\ \cos^{-1}(\cos x)<3\tan^{-1}(\tan x)\right\}$ है, जहाँ प्रतिलोम त्रिकोणमितीय फलन अपने मुख्य मान लेते हैं। यदि $S$ को बनाने वाले अन्तरालों की लम्बाइयों का योग $k\pi$ है, तो $k$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Graph of $C(x)=\cos^{-1}(\cos x)$ on $[0,2\pi]$: $C(x)=x$ for $0\le x\le\pi$ and $C(x)=2\pi-x$ for $\pi\le x\le2\pi$ (a tent with peak $\pi$ at $x=\pi$, always $\ge0$).

Graph of $T(x)=\tan^{-1}(\tan x)$: it is $x-n\pi$ where $n$ is chosen so that the value lies in $\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{2},\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$; so $T=x$ on $\left[0,\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$, $T=x-\pi$ on $\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2},\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\right)$, and $T=x-2\pi$ on $\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2},2\pi\right]$.
On $\left[0,\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$: $x<3x$ holds for $x>0$, giving $\left(0,\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$ of length $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$.

On $\left(\pi,\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\right)$: the inequality $2\pi-x<3(x-\pi)$ gives $4x>5\pi$, i.e. $x>\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$, so the part $\left(\dfrac{5\pi}{4},\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\right)$ of length $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$.
On $\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2},2\pi\right]$: $T=x-2\pi\le0\le C$, and at $x=2\pi$ both are $0$, so the strict inequality fails throughout.
originality_note: New: the tent graph of cos^-1(cos x) is compared with three times the sawtooth tan^-1(tan x) over one period, and the answer is the total length of the solution set (way 5). Closest known: solving sin^-1(sin x) = cos^-1(cos x) or sketching each composite separately. Different because: a weighted strict inequality between two different composites, with the sawtooth's negative parts removing two quarters of the period.

concept_use.Graphs of inverse trigonometric function: The solution set is read from the tent graph of cos^-1(cos x) and the sawtooth graph of tan^-1(tan x) on each of four subintervals.

stem_review: Read as a student: every function has a stated domain, every symbol is introduced before use, principal values are stated, every condition is given, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed with mpmath/numpy and is unique and equal to the Answer Plan; no hyperbolic functions or asymptotes. Checked that the points pi/2 and 3pi/2 (where tan is undefined) are excluded in the stem, that x = 0 and x = 2pi fail the strict inequality, and that the length 3pi/4 gives 0.75. Changed: No change.
key_step: Writing cos^-1(cos x) and tan^-1(tan x) piecewise on [0,2pi] and solving a linear inequality on each piece.
justification: Routine graph reading of two standard composites and four linear inequalities; several standard steps, no insight. Same demand as 2023-P1-Q8 (L2), counting solutions with tan^-1(tan x) piecewise.
